dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters with sharp step-function intensity transitions from dark exterior pixels to off-white interior boundary pixels; the internal regions of these structures show a gradual intensity decay towards a darker center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of fragmented, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated along the lower lateral boundary, characterized by high-frequency edge gradients and a lack of organized internal structure compared to the dorsal annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular quadrilateral arrangement, with the three most anterior points forming an obtuse triangle oriented towards the cephalic region.
